title: Nvidia beats Q1 FY26 estimates; data-center revenue up 73% year over year
summary: Nvidia reported fiscal Q1 revenue and adjusted EPS above Wall Street estimates, driven by data-center revenue rising 73% year over year. Shares moved higher in after-hours trading on the print.

title: Nvidia guides Q2 revenue to about $45.0B, excluding roughly $8B of lost H20 China sales
summary: Nvidia's second-quarter revenue guidance of approximately $45.0 billion explicitly excludes an estimated $8 billion of H20 accelerator revenue the company expects to forgo in China under U.S. export restrictions.

title: Nvidia takes $4.5B charge on excess H20 inventory after April 2025 China export ban
summary: Nvidia recorded a $4.5 billion charge related to excess H20 inventory and purchase obligations after new U.S. restrictions in April 2025 curtailed sales of the China-market accelerator.
